# Ingredient

_SKOS concept in the [PKM Vocabulary](../)._

An individual food item or component used in the preparation of a recipe.

## Scope note

Recipe components, as modeled in the PKMMeals Ingredient type; distinguish from Nutrition (aggregate values) and RecipeSource (provenance).

## Broader

- [Recipe](../Recipe/) — partitive (ISO 25964)
